common.title: Cinder Shift 64
menu.context: The isolation protocol has locked down Caldera 7. Prepare Mira and restore a route through the sectors to the evacuation platform.
menu.noSave: No saved shift. Start with one research point.
menu.preview: One playable mission · three rooms. This is the end of the available preview.
results.newCampaignsUnlocked: New campaigns unlocked: Small World and Adriatic Signal.
results.unlockSaveFailed: The final result could not be saved, so the new worlds are still locked. Retry the save before leaving this result.
challenge.title: Caldera trials
challenge.context: Run self-contained missions with Mira’s base suit. Challenge records never alter your campaign.
challenge.deviceUtcDate: Daily schedule uses this device’s UTC date: {date}
challenge.storageUnavailable: Local record storage is unavailable. You can still play; this run will not overwrite saved records.
challenge.readyText: The clock starts after the suit and room are ready.
challenge.eligibility.practice: Practice result · excluded from Standard records
challenge.notSaved: This result could not be saved on this device.
challenge.codeInvalid: This code is invalid or uses an unsupported setup.
challenge.codeCreated: Challenge code ready. Share it with the other player.
challenge.codeManualCopy: Clipboard is unavailable. The code is selected for manual copying.
challenge.codePreview: Preview: {mission} · {assist} · {timing} · base Mira, energy and attempts.
challenge.resultUnverified: Result from code · not independently verified
challenge.relaySupportContext: Stage A is complete. Collected intel unlocks one support package for Cargo. The next player starts with a full battery.
challenge.relayIntelContext: A sealed data shard is cached in this protected service pocket. Collecting it is optional and does not consume the repair or salvage choice.
challenge.supportNeedsIntel: Collect the relay intel to choose POWER or REPAIR.
challenge.relayCodeCreated: Handoff code ready. Share it or continue to Stage B.
challenge.relayReceiptAccepted: Relay response accepted and linked to its handoff.
challenge.relaySolo: Both stages were completed on this device.
challenge.relayShared: Stage results are linked by the handoff code; they are not a verified one-shot team run.
challenge.relayRepairContext: After collecting the core, use this separate charge once. The regular charging station remains available.
challenge.scoreBreakdown: Score breakdown · victory {victory}, optional goals {optional_goals}, walkers {walkers}, drones {drones}, turrets {turrets}, time {time_bonus}, clean run {clean_bonus}.
challenge.leaderboardUnavailable: Portal leaderboard unavailable for this build ({status}). Local play and records remain available.
challenge.medalPendingCalibration: Medals will appear after reference times are calibrated in playtests.
menu.replaceText: The current shift, research and rewards will be replaced. Language and control settings stay.
menu.restartText: Room positions are not saved across closing the game. Continue starts the mission with its entry loadout, full energy and a fresh attempt allowance. Death during play restarts the current screen.
privacy.title: Analytics preferences
privacy.description: Allow visit and gameplay statistics for Nuts Games? You can play without analytics and change this choice at any time.
privacy.unset: Analytics are off until you allow them.
research.title: Suit workshop
research.context: Inspect a module, then confirm the purchase. You may keep your point and deploy with the base suit.
research.W1.name: Splitter
research.W1.effect: Fire three projectiles in a fan. Catch several targets with one shot.
research.M1.name: Ground impulse
research.M1.effect: A short ground dash. Recharges in 3 s; walls stop the suit.
research.D1.name: Projectile shield
research.D1.effect: Absorbs the first enemy projectile in each screen without battery damage. Revisiting does not refill it.
research.W3.name: Ricochet core
research.W3.effect: Reflect one shot from a marked ricochet panel.
research.W4.name: Capacitor shot
research.W4.effect: Active shot deals 4 damage and recharges in 5 s. Uses the active slot.
research.M3.name: Magnetic traverse
research.M3.effect: During an active dash, the suit can pass through marked walls.
research.M4.name: Phase circuit
research.M4.effect: During a dash, pass through marked energy curtains. Ordinary walls still stop the suit.
research.D3.name: Discharge pulse
research.D3.effect: When the room buffer absorbs a hit, it also clears enemy projectiles.
research.D4.name: Reserve section
research.D4.effect: Once per mission, survive a lethal hit with 25% battery. Does not protect against time or firing costs.
research.confirmText: Purchase {node} for 1 point? It applies to the next mission entry.
mission.name: Airlock
mission.goal: Restore the emergency line and leave
mission.route: A suit check → B service corridor → vent gallery → optional salvage → security crossing → C power cabinet and evacuation. Combat doors require clearing powered threats.
mission.retryRule: Energy powers your suit: time, firing and hits drain it. At zero, one attempt is lost and this screen restarts with its entry charge and resources.
mission.conditionClosed: The upper maintenance passage is closed. Take the ground route.
mission.repairSlot: The service pocket recharges up to one third of the battery. Some caches offer salvage instead.
mission.objective.power: Restore the emergency line in room C
mission.objective.corridor: Cross the corridor. Cover blocks fire; the upper shelf changes firing height.
mission.objective.closed: Upper route locked. Cross below the shutter; cover still blocks fire.
mission.objective.hold: Hold {action} for {seconds} s to restore power
events.title: Service cache
events.context: Choose a recharge of up to one third of the battery or salvage worth 150 points. Use the cache once.
events.once: One claim per attempt. No research points are awarded.
events.beaconContext: Scout the next screen or recharge up to one sixth of the battery. Either choice uses the cache.
events.salvageContext: Optional pickup. Collect 150 salvage score; it does not change access to the navigation data.
events.patrolContext: Activate the patrol to face a ram worth 250 points. You can leave the patrol inactive.
repair.title: {slot} / Recharge
repair.context: This service pocket recharges up to one third of the battery. Unused charge cannot be stored.
repair.once: One charge per mission. A full battery leaves it available.
results.reason.beacon-warden-shot: A shot from the Beacon Warden
results.reason.rift-marshal-shot: A shot from the Rift Marshal
results.reason.security-aimed-shot: An aimed shot from a security guard
results.reward: First victory in this mission: +1 research point
results.noReward: This mission grants no additional research point.
results.deathReward: No research points for a failed attempt. Retry keeps the entry loadout and event plan.
results.campaignCheckpoint: The Archive chapter is complete. Its data opens the route to the Reactor; this campaign branch currently ends at a checkpoint.
results.campaignEnd: All five sectors are complete. Mira reached the evacuation platform.
results.bestScore: Best campaign score for this content build: {score}
results.noBestScore: No completed campaign record exists for this content build yet.
results.recordPending: The campaign record is not stored yet. It will retry when you reopen this result.
results.partialHistory: Some history from before this content version could not be reconstructed.
results.assisted: This campaign used longer enemy warning times.
settings.title: Suit settings
settings.autofireHint: Auto-fire uses the same weapon effect and only targets visible enemies in front of the suit.
settings.combatAssistHint: Enemy attack warnings last 50% longer. Campaign records are marked Assisted.
settings.rebindConflict: That key is already assigned to another action.
settings.controls.keyboard: {left}/{right}: move · {jump}: jump · {crouch}: crouch · {fire}: fire · {interact}: interact · {ability}: active skill · {pause}: pause
settings.controls.touch: Left: movement and crouch. Right: jump, fire and interaction. Impulse appears only when equipped.
settings.controls.gamepad: Stick/D-pad: move · A: jump/confirm · RT: fire · X: interact · B: impulse/back in menus · Menu: pause
settings.navigation: Menus: Tab or arrows to select · Enter/Space to confirm · Esc to go back. Gamepad: D-pad, A and B.
settings.telemetry: Gameplay statistics are sent only with analytics consent. Diagnostics stay in this tab.
pause.title: Pause
pause.manual: World and sound are paused. Resume explicitly when ready.
pause.blur: The window lost focus. World, timers and sound are paused.
pause.hidden: The tab is in the background. World, timers and sound are paused.
pause.portrait: Rotate your phone to landscape. Then resume explicitly.
pause.save: Continue after a reload returns to the mission entrance with the same loadout and events.
training.note: TRAINING · no campaign progress or rewards
errors.title: Restart required
errors.load: Resources could not be loaded. Reload to try again.
errors.context: The browser lost the graphics context. Reload returns to the mission entrance if saving is available.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.save.unavailable: Storage is unavailable. This shift works in memory; closing or reloading may lose progress.
errors.save.write_failed: Saving failed. The current shift continues in memory; progress is not safely stored.
errors.save.corrupt: The saved shift is damaged. It has not been erased. Start a new shift only after confirming replacement.
errors.save.incompatible: This save uses an unsupported version. It has not been erased. Reset the shift explicitly to play this version.
errors.save.unknown_nodes: The save contains unknown research modules. Progress is kept; confirm replacement to start a new shift.
errors.resetText: This replaces only campaign progress. Language, sound and control settings stay.
accessibility.game: Game field. Controls are available in Settings.
accessibility.fps: Frame rate over the last minute
meta.description: Cinder Shift 64 — a playable emergency shift on Caldera 7. Nuts Games.
errors.save.replaceUnknown: Storage cannot be read right now. Starting a new shift may replace an earlier save when saving becomes available. Start a new shift?
character.title: Choose an operator
character.mira.name: Mira Vey
character.portrait: Mira in the equipped engineering suit
character.context: Mira is ready for the emergency shift. Other operators will become available later.
workshop.nextEntry: Modules apply on the next mission entry. Viewing modules does not spend research points.
workshop.spreadNote: Three projectiles: straight and at ±10°. Spread does not guarantee three hits. Projectile damage and fire rate stay the same.
workshop.dash: Ground dash: up to {distance} px in {seconds} s; cooldown {cooldown} s. No extra invulnerability.
workshop.salvage: Optional salvage score: {score}. It is separate from research points; bypassing robots is allowed.
workshop.deathHint.drone: Change height or take cover before the drone fires. A projectile shield absorbs the first shot on each screen.
workshop.deathHint.walker: Use cover or crouch under the walker fire. Retry keeps the entry loadout and event plan.
workshop.deathHint.unknown: Watch the warning and use cover. Retry restores this screen’s entry charge and resources.
audio.title: Audio mixer
audio.unavailable: Some sounds are unavailable. The shift remains playable.
research.W2.name: Piercer
research.W2.effect: Normal shots pass through one light target or a marked thin sheet.
research.M2.name: Air jets
research.M2.effect: Use the dash in midair with the same shared recharge.
research.D2.name: Reserve buffer
research.D2.effect: Absorbs one additional hit per screen after the projectile shield, or a hit from a hazard. Revisiting does not refill it.
cargo.name: Cargo sector
cargo.goal: Reroute equipment, recover the energy cell, install it, and clear the checkpoint
cargo.route: Receiving dock → gallery → turret line → salvage shelves → power routing → equipment → storage → service switchboard → checkpoint.
cargo.conditionOff: The storage turret and upper passage have lost power. Use the lower route to reach the energy cell.
cargo.conditionNone: The upper storage passage is open. The storage turret is offline.
cargo.objective.cell: Find the energy cell in storage.
cargo.objective.install: Cell collected. Install it in the switchboard.
cargo.objective.exit: Cell installed. Clear the perimeter and confirm the Cargo exit.
cargo.objective.take: Press {action} to collect the energy cell.
cargo.objective.restore: Press {action} to open the short passage and power the late turret.
mission.subtitle.D: Security walkers pursue. Cover breaks their line of sight.
mission.subtitle.E: The teaching turret is always powered. Watch its longer first cycle from cover.
mission.subtitle.F: The lower passage reaches the energy cell regardless of the storage power.
mission.subtitle.G: The cell is already installed. Clear security and the perimeter turret, then confirm the exit.
map.title: Caldera 7 map
map.context: Mira’s route through the complex. Inspecting a node changes neither progress nor position.
map.foundryGoal: Reroute machinery, choose a route and shut down the Foundry.
map.archiveGoal: Recover the carrier, connect upload power, transmit the archive and clear its exit.
foundry.conditionHeat: Extra heat on the press route. The switch powers one machine at a time.
foundry.conditionNone: The press route has normal temperatures.
archive.conditionBeacon: The beacon offers reconnaissance or a recharge of up to one sixth of the battery.
archive.conditionNone: The cache contains salvage worth 150 points. More security waits in the Data Hall.
foundry.fork.title: Foundry / choose a route
foundry.fork.context: The line is isolated. Both routes lead to a service stop before the final fight.
foundry.fork.serviceBody: Three encounters across service catwalks: vertical fire, a drone gallery, then security and a turret. No industrial hazard cycles.
foundry.fork.pressBody: Three production encounters: a press with a ram, a furnace hall, then alternating presses. Read safe windows and choose the salvage risk.
foundry.subtitle.M3A: Dodge the armored ram; counterattack when its engine opens.
foundry.subtitle.M3B: Use the catwalk to change the firing line.
foundry.subtitle.M3C: The press and ram have separate warnings.
foundry.subtitle.M3D: Clear the final encounter and stop the line.
foundry.objective.line: Stop the line at both terminals.
foundry.objective.terminal: Defeat the threat, then activate terminal 1.
foundry.objective.route: Choose the Service bypass or Press corridor.
foundry.objective.press: Read the press windows and cross to the cooling loop.
foundry.objective.heat: Watch the heat signal. The shelter is on the left.
reactor.subtitle.M5A: Two threats cover different lanes. The marked curtain can be crossed during a dash with M4.
reactor.subtitle.M5B: Watch the heat warning from cover. The patrol is optional.
reactor.subtitle.M5C: A safe repair and a clear view of the arena. No enemies or hazards enter here.
reactor.subtitle.M5D: Two Regulator phases. The reflector returns a Splitter pellet to the open core.
reactor.subtitle.M5E: The complex is quiet. Reach the evacuation platform.
reactor.objective.blockade: Clear security, then connect the outer circuit.
reactor.objective.transit: Outer circuit connected. Continue through the coolant crossing.
reactor.objective.heat: Read the heat cycle and cross to the service camera.
reactor.objective.patrol: The patrol stays inactive until you call it.
reactor.objective.patrolActive: Defeat the ram to reopen the door and earn 250 points.
reactor.objective.service: Recharge up to one third of the battery before entering the arena.
reactor.objective.boss: Integrity {hp}. Amber marks a beam warning; red marks its active lane.
reactor.objective.bossDown: Regulator disabled. The evacuation door is open.
reactor.objective.evacuation: Reach the evacuation platform to finish the campaign.
archive.subtitle.M4A: A low guard holds the firing lane into the stacks.
archive.subtitle.M4B: Defeat security to reach the cache. The recon beacon can offer a repair or a preview of the next room.
archive.subtitle.M4C: Bring the carrier and connect upload power. A repair kit is available after transmission.
archive.subtitle.M4D: Clear the low guard before the drone responds; transmitted data is required at the exit.
archive.objective.data: Recover the carrier and power its upload circuit.
archive.objective.sorting: Open access to the navigation archive.
archive.objective.beacon: Choose reconnaissance or a recharge of up to 17%.
archive.objective.beaconChoice: Press {action} to use the recon beacon.
archive.objective.upload: Carrier ready. Hold the terminal to upload the data.
archive.objective.scouted: Scout route open; connect power before uploading the carrier.
archive.objective.holdUpload: Hold {action} for {seconds} s to upload the data.
archive.objective.transit: Data uploaded. Repair is available before transit.
archive.objective.exit: Use the data and reach the exit on the right.
map.reactorGoal: Disable the Regulator and reach the evacuation platform.
map.reactorRoute: Blockade → cooling → heat collector → relay → power routing → service stop → Regulator → evacuation.
map.evacuation: Final destination: the evacuation platform beyond the Reactor. It is not a sixth mission.
results.airlockExit: The Airlock leads deeper into the complex. Restore power in the Cargo sector next.
repair.r02Context: After collecting the core, use this cache once to recharge up to one third of the battery.
cargo.objective.turretHint: Turret armor open — fire now to damage it.
cargo.objective.turretArmor: The turret is armored. After its burst, shoot the exposed turquoise core.
cargo.objective.turretOff: The turret has no power and does not block the route. Collect the cell.
cargo.objective.turretRestore: The turret has no power. The entrance console powers it and opens the shortcut; you can collect the cell below.
rework.activeIdle: Purchased · select in the active slot
arrival.title: CALDERA COMPLEX
arrival.description: A shuttle docks at an industrial complex. Mira disembarks as an emergency alarm begins.
arrival.approach: Approach confirmed. Docking at the outer airlock.
arrival.disembark: Mira Vey, on site. Restore the transit power.
arrival.emergency: Emergency lockdown. Reach the Regulator and open an evacuation route.
rework.evacuationComplete: Evacuation complete. The complex is shut down. Review your shift results.
foundry.subtitle.M3E: One supply, two machines. The console changes the active hazard.
foundry.subtitle.M3F: Defeat security, isolate the feed and choose a route.
foundry.subtitle.M3G: Drones hold different heights. Salvage is on the upper shelf.
foundry.subtitle.M3H: Break the security line before crossing to the cooling loop.
foundry.subtitle.M3I: Move above the furnace lane; cover separates the threats.
foundry.subtitle.M3J: The presses alternate. Wait in a safe position, then commit.
foundry.subtitle.M3K: A quiet repair stop before the final fight. Restart the cooling supply.
foundry.objective.M3A: Defeat the ram and enter the distributor.
foundry.objective.M3E: Choose the powered machine, then clear the combined encounter.
foundry.objective.M3F: Clear security and activate the route terminal.
foundry.objective.M3G: Reach the drones at their height; the upper salvage is optional.
foundry.objective.M3H: Use cover between the security walker and the turret.
foundry.objective.M3C: Dodge the ram without entering the active press.
foundry.objective.M3I: Cross the furnace lane and clear the hall.
foundry.objective.M3J: Read each press separately and defeat the ram.
foundry.objective.M3K: Repair if needed, then restore cooling at the terminal.
foundry.objective.M3D: Clear the ram and drone, then hold the shutdown terminal.
foundry.ramArmor: Ram armor closed. Dodge the charge; attack the open engine afterward.
foundry.powerSwitch.press: Presses powered, furnace off. {action}: switch power to the furnace.
foundry.powerSwitch.furnace: Furnace powered, presses off. {action}: switch power to the presses.
regulator.laneWarning: Regulator {hp} HP · marked strike locked. Move out of the lane.
regulator.lanes: Regulator {hp} HP · evade the two marked strikes.
regulator.coreOpen: Regulator {hp} HP · chest core open. Shoot from the platform or jump.
regulator.overload: Regulator {hp} HP · core overload, shutters closing. Prepare for the next strike.
regulator.phaseChange: Regulator {hp} HP · armor is shifting. A full sweep is next.
regulator.sweepWarning: Regulator {hp} HP · sweep incoming. Reach the left service alcove.
regulator.sweep: Regulator {hp} HP · keep outside the sweep, then return to the open core.
cargo.subtitle.M2A: Change your firing height to clear the drone.
cargo.subtitle.M2B: The lower route is mandatory; salvage above is optional.
cargo.subtitle.M2C: This console controls the next equipment bay.
cargo.subtitle.M2D: The console powers either the conveyor or its guard turret.
cargo.subtitle.M2E: Repair after collecting the cell, then install it before the checkpoint.
cargo.objective.gallery: Clear the gallery drone from a different firing height.
cargo.objective.salvageRoute: Clear the lower route. The cargo on the upper shelf is optional.
cargo.objective.routePower: Choose the next equipment bay’s power at the entrance console.
cargo.equipment.security: Turret powered, belt stopped. Fire after its burst.
cargo.equipment.conveyor: Belt pulls left; turret is off. Use the upper route to avoid the belt.
map.archiveRoute: Sorting → shelves → beacon → patrol → upload power → gallery → transmission → exit.
archive.subtitle.M4E: Climb the shelves and physically recover the data carrier.
archive.subtitle.M4F: Scouting opens the screen and lengthens enemy warnings.
archive.subtitle.M4G: A direct base-weapon lane passes beneath the reflective panel.
archive.subtitle.M4H: The marksman locks your position; the drone follows the duel.
archive.subtitle.M4I: Jump the ram charge and fire during engine recovery.
archive.objective.carrier: Recover the physical carrier on the upper shelf.
archive.objective.takeCarrier: Press {action} to take the archive carrier.
archive.objective.openScreen: Scout route open. Enemy warnings are longer.
archive.objective.closedScreen: The screen blocks the floor lane. Clear it by jumping over.
archive.objective.connect: Clear this patrol and connect the upload circuit.
archive.objective.powered: Upload circuit connected. Reach the cross-level gallery.
archive.objective.mixed: Clear the floor guard and the raised drone line.
archive.objective.needPower: Upload has no power. Connect the circuit in the preceding sector room.
archive.objective.ram: Evade the charge, then counter the exposed ram engine.
archive.objective.final: Clear both threats and confirm the transmitted-data exit.
archive.objective.guardCache: Defeat the guard to reach the cache.
airlock.subtitle.M1A: The upper firing line reaches the drone. Read its warning before crossing.
airlock.subtitle.M1B: Clear the lower guard. The upper salvage cache is optional.
airlock.subtitle.M1C: The guard comes first. Shelter from the turret burst, then counter its open core.
airlock.objective.M1A: Change firing height to clear the vent drone.
airlock.objective.M1B: Clear security; climb for optional salvage.
airlock.objective.M1C: Clear the guard, then fire into the turret recovery window.
reactor.subtitle.M5F: Cross the warned vent, then separate the drone and security firing lines.
reactor.subtitle.M5G: Defeat the lower guard before climbing into the landing-control drone lane.
reactor.subtitle.M5H: Cooling stops the next vent but keeps its turret powered. Isolation cuts the turret and leaves the vent hot.
reactor.subtitle.M5I: Counter the ram. Your power choice controls the last turret and heat vent.
reactor.objective.M5F: Use the cooling window and the raised firing line.
reactor.objective.M5G: Clear the floor guard, then climb to answer the drone.
reactor.objective.M5H: Allocate power at the console before leaving.
reactor.objective.M5I: Dodge the ram and counter. Read the powered equipment ahead.
reactor.power.unset: Press {action}: cooling disables heat and powers the guard turret. Press again for isolation.
reactor.power.cooling: Cooling: next vent OFF, guard turret ON. Press {action} to isolate security.
reactor.power.isolation: Isolation: guard turret OFF, next vent ON. Press {action} to restore cooling.
archive.objective.aimedTracking: Armored marksman: wait for the aiming mark to lock.
archive.objective.aimedLocked: Aim locked: change position, then counter the open armor.
rw2.training: Learn movement, firing and the dash in a safe practice room. No campaign progress is spent.
rw2.mode.time: Finish a fixed route quickly. Compare your best time.
rw2.mode.score: Collect salvage and clear threats to improve your score.
rw2.mode.daily: A shared seeded challenge that changes every UTC day.
rw2.mode.relay: Two connected stages. Carry a partner's support into the second leg.
rw2.story.airlock: Emergency line connected. Freight motors answer across the bulkhead.
rw2.story.cargo: The cell is installed. The Foundry supply line is open.
rw2.story.foundry: Foundry supply restored. The Archive uplink can now be reached.
rw2.story.archive: The data is uploaded. Only the Reactor stands between Mira and evacuation.
rw2.story.reactor: The Regulator is silent. Mira reaches the evacuation shuttle.
notes.title: What’s new
world.title: Campaigns
world.c01.description: Restore five sectors and reach the evacuation platform.
world.c02.description: A small explorer in a house of enormous proportions.
world.load_failed: Progress could not be loaded. Try again.
worlds.SW01.name: Kitchen Canyon
worlds.SW01.route: Pick up the lid, crouch under the mug handle, then throw it into the open contact.
worlds.SW02.name: Desktop Orbit
worlds.SW02.route: Keys form a lower route and an upper route. The scanner watches the far row.
worlds.SW03.name: The Big Wash
worlds.SW03.goal: Close the vent and recover fragment two.
worlds.SW03.route: Carry the block along stable cloth folds to the open contact.
worlds.SW04.name: Balcony Wind
worlds.SW04.goal: Read the gusts and recover fragment three.
worlds.SW04.route: Leaves show the wind. The inner path stays sheltered; salvage waits higher up.
worlds.SW05.name: Router Summit
worlds.SW05.goal: Assemble three fragments and restore your scale.
worlds.SW05.route: Books and cable clips lead upward. The beacon is visible ahead.
worlds.YU01.name: Telephone Exchange
worlds.YU01.route: Switch the safe lever to B, then activate the illuminated line contact.
worlds.YU02.name: Night Harbour
worlds.YU02.route: Choose gate power or lift power. Every configuration retains a lower return route.
worlds.YU03.name: Last Electric Train
worlds.YU03.goal: Isolate traction and restore the substation.
worlds.YU03.route: Isolate the traction section with B before activating the service crossing.
worlds.YU04.name: Factory Hum
worlds.YU04.goal: Disable the anomalous drive and open the radio channel.
worlds.YU04.route: Inspect both conveyor configurations. The side walkway always remains open.
worlds.YU05.name: Radio Above the Bay
worlds.YU05.goal: Connect the antenna and close the rift.
worlds.YU05.route: The bay marks your destination. Switch the protected approach before the final ascent.
worlds.hint.SW01-A: Throw the lid into the contact to open the drawer gate. The upper resource is optional.
worlds.hint.SW01-B: Three nozzles vent steam. Crouch below the jets or wait for them to stop.
worlds.hint.SW01-C: Follow the handles down. A repair pocket waits beyond the contact.
worlds.hint.SW01-D: Take cover, wait for the scan and throw into the open dock contact. Each connection changes the cover.
worlds.hint.SW02-A: Step on key I to lower key II briefly. Choose the lower row or the upper shortcut before the scanner.
worlds.hint.SW02-B: Carry the spool to the cable latch. Put it down to fight, then pick it up again.
worlds.hint.SW02-C: The printer warns before extending its paper platform. Use the paper or crouch under the fixed supports; the tray waits until you step off.
worlds.hint.SW02-D: Carry the reflector to each contact. Wait for the warm scan to clear and the contact to open before throwing. Two scans open the exit.
worlds.hint.SW03-A: Throw the spool into the basket catch to lower the strap. The lower path stays open.
worlds.hint.SW03-B: Permanent pegs lead around the moving cloth. A carried lid blocks fire and absorbs one hit.
worlds.hint.SW03-C: Watch the vent flag before a gust. Crouch in the lower pocket; the usual jump is enough.
worlds.hint.SW03-D: Carry the weight to close the damper, wait for it to settle, then connect the fragment contact.
worlds.hint.SW04-A: The leaves and flag warn before wind crosses the upper route. The pot path stays sheltered.
worlds.hint.SW04-B: Use the moving towel or the stable lower route. Crouch to resist the gust.
worlds.hint.SW04-C: Watch the gutter warning. Wait in a dry pocket, then cross the short water pulse with the lid.
worlds.hint.SW04-D: Connect three familiar contacts between safe pockets. Watch the wind and the last pulse.
worlds.hint.SW05-A: Books and cable clips lead upward. The beacon is visible ahead.
worlds.hint.SW05-B: Carry the conductor, clear the service drone with free hands, then finish the feed.
worlds.hint.SW05-C: Install the three beacon connections in order. All three fragments must be earned.
worlds.hint.SW05-D: Read the scan: the first screen shields the beam while its lower slit keeps your firing lane open. Throw only into an open panel.
worlds.hint.YU01-A: Set the courtyard lever to B: the stair lights and entrance open. The upper alcove has optional salvage.
worlds.hint.YU01-B: Switch on bridge B at the entrance. The crate on the left is your first step.
worlds.hint.YU01-C: B opens the roof screen and supplies lower cover. Take the sheltered route or climb the roofs for salvage.
worlds.hint.YU01-D: Prepare the B feed and A isolator. Then select B, wait for the green signal and confirm the transmitter.
worlds.exchange.selectB: Use {action} at the lever to power bridge B.
worlds.exchange.fromRight: Jump onto the cabinet left of the lever, then onto the bridge towards the two lights.
worlds.exchange.crate: Return to the crate on the left and jump from it onto the bridge.
worlds.exchange.bridge: Jump from the crate onto the bridge. Use {action} at the two lights in the middle.
worlds.exchange.lever: Use {action} at the right lever to restore circuit A.
worlds.exchange.cross: Jump from the right edge of the bridge onto the cabinet. The lever is below on the right.
worlds.exchange.lower: The cabinet blocks the floor. Use {action} at the left lever to select A.
worlds.exchange.stairs: Jump from the crate up the two A steps, then over the cabinet to the right.
worlds.exchange.confirm: Use {action} at the single light beside the right lever on the floor.
worlds.exchange.drone: Power restored. Clear the drone at the exit.
worlds.exchange.return: Cross to the far lever and restore A. Confirm the one-lamp exit contact with {action}.
worlds.firstLine.0: Select B. Connect the first feed at the two-lamp contact with {action}.
worlds.firstLine.1: Restore A at the far lever. Confirm the isolator with {action}; this starts the warned pulse.
worlds.firstLine.2: Select B to open the screen. Wait outside the pulse for green, then confirm the transmitter with {action}.
worlds.hint.YU02-A: Choose gate power or lift power. Every configuration retains a lower return route.
worlds.hint.YU02-B: Position the crane platform in B, then restore A at the next line contact.
worlds.hint.YU02-C: The safety markings stay visible when the lights change. Repair waits after the drone.
worlds.hint.YU02-D: Prepare the relay through three visible circuit contacts. Read the pulse before sending.
worlds.hint.YU03-A: Isolate the traction section with B before activating the service crossing.
worlds.hint.YU03-B: Switch the carriage doors and lights. Fixed platforms remain usable in both circuits.
worlds.hint.YU03-C: Use the tunnel pockets and read the pulse. The right pocket contains repair.
worlds.hint.YU03-D: Separate crossing power from the transmitter isolator, then confirm the substation.
worlds.hint.YU04-A: Inspect both conveyor configurations. The side walkway always remains open.
worlds.hint.YU04-B: Power the hoist, cross the fixed supports, then restore the exit circuit.
worlds.hint.YU04-C: Two reachable switches feed the distributor. Clear the scanner with the next step visible.
worlds.hint.YU04-D: Disable shielding, use the safe pulse window and restore the machine route.
worlds.hint.YU05-A: The bay marks your destination. Switch the protected approach before the final ascent.
worlds.hint.YU05-B: Choose the covered lower gallery or optional upper bridge. Every stable point has a return.
worlds.hint.YU05-C: Secure the three antenna connections. Completed transmissions remain recorded.
worlds.hint.YU05-D: Prepare the circuit, wait under cover, activate the exposed contact and close the rift.
worlds.carry: {action}: throw · crouch + {action}: put down. Free your hands to fire.
worlds.exit: Route ready. Proceed to the right exit.
worlds.contactOpen: Square panel open: aim the item at the contact · {action}
worlds.powerGoal: Contact {count}/{total}: circuit {circuit}. Match the lamps, approach the contact and press {action}.
worlds.ending.c02-small-world: The beacon is assembled. Scale restored; the house is quiet again.
worlds.ending.c03-adriatic-1986: The bay answers. The rift is closed and the city remains at peace.
worlds.encounter.settling: Phase {phase}/{total}: step clear of the changing cover.
worlds.encounter.warning: Phase {phase}/{total}: take cover. The scan is charging.
worlds.encounter.scan: Phase {phase}/{total}: stay behind cover during the scan.
worlds.encounter.closing: Phase {phase}/{total}: panel closing. Recover the item and wait for the next warning.
worlds.encounter.complete: All contacts are connected. Confirm the beacon.
worlds.traction.warning: Traction warning. Circuit B disconnects the service crossing - {action}.
worlds.traction.live: Live traction section. Switch to B before crossing - {action}.
worlds.traction.isolated: Traction disconnected. Cross to the lit contact and confirm - {action}.
worlds.substation.1: Crossing secured. Select A and confirm the isolator at the second marker - {action}.
worlds.substation.2: Isolator set. Select B, read the signal and confirm the transmission - {action}.
worlds.harbor.gate: Select B to open the warehouse gate. The powered upper platform leads to optional salvage. {action}: confirm the far contact.
worlds.harbor.crane: Select B and climb onto the lowered crane platform. Connect its two-lamp contact with {action}; wait outside the marked load lane.
worlds.harbor.exit: Cross the marked crane lane on green. Restore A at the far lever, then confirm the exit contact with {action}.
worlds.harbor.quay: A powers the quay lamps; B opens the screen. Water markers stay visible in either circuit. {action}: confirm the far contact.
worlds.harbor.relay.0: Select B and climb onto the cargo platform. {action}: connect its two-lamp feed; this starts the warned pulse.
worlds.harbor.relay.1: Leave the platform before switching. Restore A at the far lever and confirm the one-lamp shield contact with {action}.
worlds.harbor.relay.2: Select B to open the relay screen. Wait in the dry pocket for green, then confirm the last contact with {action}.
worlds.factory.entry: A powers the belt and closes the shortcut. The upper walkway leads to salvage. B stops the belt and opens the passage. Confirm the far contact: {action}.
worlds.factory.hoist.0: Select B, climb onto the lowered hoist and connect its two-lamp contact: {action}.
worlds.factory.hoist.1: Cross to the permanent support. Restore A at the far lever, then confirm the exit contact: {action}.
worlds.factory.distributor.0: Select B and climb the side supports to the distributor. Connect the upper feed: {action}.
worlds.factory.distributor.1: Upper feed secured. Restore A at the far lever and confirm the lower exit feed: {action}.
worlds.factory.drive.0: Select B and climb to the isolator. {action}: release the first screen; this starts the drive warning.
worlds.factory.drive.1: Use the upper walkway or cross on green. Select A at the far support and reset the drive in its safe window: {action}.
worlds.factory.drive.2: Drive stopped. Select B, pass the open screen and secure the radio feed at the last contact: {action}.
worlds.radio.ascent: The station is above the bay. Switch to B to light the safe line; the upper ledges hold optional salvage.
worlds.radio.galleryBridge: Power B: take the fast lower lane between pulses, or climb onto the protected bridge.
worlds.radio.galleryReturn: First feed secured. Return to a lever and restore A; both routes remain open to the switches.
worlds.radio.link0: Secure link 1 of 3 on B. Confirmed antenna links survive Retry and reload.
worlds.radio.link1: Link 1 saved. Restore A and confirm the middle connection.
worlds.radio.link2: Two links saved. Select B and confirm the final connection.
worlds.radio.tune: Tune B at the first contact. This starts a full warning before the rift pulse.
worlds.radio.shelter: Shelter under the marked canopy during the pulse. Restore A and confirm the second feed in the safe window.
worlds.radio.close: Containment released. Select B and close the rift at the final contact.
records.title: Personal records
records.temporary: Session only: the latest statistics have not been saved.
records.newCounters: Earlier shots and play time cannot be recovered. Existing saved records remain available.
records.incompleteHistory: Incomplete history; excluded from comparable best runs
records.noCampaigns: Complete a campaign to record a run here.
records.noTrials: Finish or leave a trial to record an attempt here.
pause.host: Paused by the platform. Wait for the platform window to close.
